S50.01.needs: a device with sound output; a chat with a finished assistant reply
S50.01.note: The exact way the action row appears on screen (always shown or after a tap) was not verified; read-aloud can also show a 'not available' reason for some account states.
steps: Sign in and open a chat that already has an assistant reply.
Find the action row under the assistant reply (Copy, Read aloud, Regenerate response, More message actions).
Look for the reply being spoken aloud, and for the button label changing to Stop reading aloud. Compare with Expected: the reply plays as speech.
S50.01.where: Chat > any assistant reply > Read aloud (Read aloud button in the reply's action row; it changes to Stop reading aloud while playing)

S50.02.needs: none (a Free account works; voice-mode list only appears when live voice is available for the account)
S50.02.note: The Settings menu label comes from the shared translation file packages/ui/i18n/locales/en/common.json; the side-menu gesture to open it was not verified; the Voice row on the Voice screen opens the Voice & Language screen, so its selection (voice) is shown there, not on the Voice screen itself.
steps: Open the side menu and tap Settings.
Tap the Speech language row and pick a language in the sheet, then close it.
Tap the Voice row to open the Voice & Language screen.
Look at the Speaking style list and the installed voice list, tap a voice, and compare what is shown as selected with Expected.
S50.02.where: Settings > Voice > Voice & Language (open the Voice row, then the Voice row again; Speech language is the row above it)

S50.03.needs: a device with sound output; a chat with an assistant reply
S50.03.note: No separate support check for speed was found; the slider is always shown, and the value is passed to the device speech engine in apps/mobile/src/features/voice/services/tts.ts (rate option); the rate for cloud server speech was not verified.
steps: Open the side menu and tap Settings.
Drag the slider labelled Speed to a different value (range 0.5x to 2x, steps of 0.05).
Tap Read aloud on an assistant reply in a chat, then listen and compare with Expected: the speed of spoken playback changes with the slider.
S50.03.where: Settings > Voice > Speed (slider with value shown as 0.50x to 2.00x)
